scope: EDNS metadata integration into address selection and live search; pure suite uses installed compiler, live suite uses isolated telescope-cache/GC experiment.

pure.scope:
Pure address-answer selection against an independent record-set model.

Generated DNS packets include binary names, aliases, section separation and
malformed relevant RDATA. This is not a complete stub resolver or DNSSEC test.

live.scope:
Single-server DNS search over real loopback TCP exchanges.

Checks DNS RCODE classification, selected-empty replies, search precedence,
alias follow-ups, refusal, EOF/reset/partial framing, shared deadline and
terminal source/validation/abort errors.
This is not a server retry, OS configuration or full resolver test.

c.note: C emitted by profile-bend.py with telescope cache clearing and explicit GC; unchanged compiler exceeded 16 and 20 GiB guards.

limitations: Unchanged OS-primitive compiler candidate exceeded 16 and 20 GiB C-emission guards.
Live native/JS binaries were generated by the explicitly isolated cache-clearing/GC candidate; no compiler patch was installed.
Live OPT responses are deliberately unsolicited on the current plain-query path. Request negotiation and fallback remain pending.
